_help: You can keep this key for documentation, the app will ignore it.

profile.target_roles: Backend Engineer, Python Developer, Software Engineer

hard_gates: The posting restricts applicants to a country, region, or time zone outside the candidate's preferences (check both location metadata and description).
The work arrangement (remote, hybrid, on-site) or contract type violates the candidate's preferences.
The seniority level exceeds the candidate's preferences (a 1-2 year stretch is acceptable only when the core tech stack matches closely).
The primary focus of the role does not align with {target_roles}.
The job description explicitly mentions a dealbreaker or non-accepted working language listed in the preferences.

scoring_weights.name: Core skills overlap
scoring_weights.what: Direct overlap between required core technologies and skills demonstrated in the CV; do not award high marks for shared secondary tools if the primary stack is mismatched.

scoring_weights.name: Experience and seniority fit
scoring_weights.what: Alignment of required years of experience and career stage with the CV and preferences.

scoring_weights.name: Role and domain fit
scoring_weights.what: Title alignment with target backend/software roles and relevance of CV projects to the role's problem space.

scoring_weights.name: Nice-to-haves
scoring_weights.what: Secondary tools, cloud/CI workflows, testing experience, and soft skills.
